label: Figure 15.3: Shifts in SRAS
alt: Three parallel upward-sloping SRAS curves: SRAS3 above and to the left, SRAS1 in the middle and SRAS2 below and to the right, with purple arrows from SRAS1 to each of the others.
caption: The original curve is SRAS<sub>1</sub>. Falling costs of production shift it right to SRAS<sub>2</sub> (an increase in SRAS: more output supplied at every price level). Rising costs shift it left to SRAS<sub>3</sub> (a decrease in SRAS). The purple arrows show each shift from SRAS<sub>1</sub>.
